# Porphyry

*234 – 305 · Greek · [Neoplatonism](../movements/neoplatonism.md)*

Greek philosopher born in Tyre, a pupil of [Plotinus](../philosophers/plotinus.md) whose treatises he edited as the *[Enneads](../works/enneads-plotinus.md)*; his Isagoge, an introduction to Aristotle's logic, served as a textbook throughout the Middle Ages.
